title: A rep with no invoice of the chosen Sales Type leaves the report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Today {Sales-rep-A} holds only the Labor side of one invoiced split work order, and {Sales-rep-B} holds its Parts side; neither has other invoices today.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, with Show Unassigned on. The Sales Type column is on
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Select only "Parts" in the Sales Type filter.
  2. Click the Sales Type column header.
  3. Select only "Labor".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Sales-rep-A} disappears (no blank row); {Sales-rep-B} shows with the Parts row.
  • Step 2: nothing happens; the Sales Type column cannot be sorted.
  • Step 3: {Sales-rep-A} shows with the Labor row and {Sales-rep-B} disappears.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-R2: “Any combination can be selected. Rows, summary rows, totals and invoice counts follow the selection (S5-R10 to S5-R12).”

From: "SBR (Sales By Representative) Report" spec, Confluence 585629698, version 28 (12 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026

  • Sales By Representative spec, S5-R1: “A sales rep occupies a summary row if and only if they have at least one non-reversed invoice matching the current filter set (date range, sales type, invoice status, and location, together). Reps with no matching invoices do not appear — there is no blank placeholder row. A rep's current active/inactive (toggle) state does not affect whether they appear, only how they are labeled (S5-R9).”
  • Sales By Representative spec, S11-R6: “Identifier columns are not sortable (Date, Invoice, Customer, Status, Sales Type do not respond to header clicks). The Date header carries the expand/collapse-all chevron, not a sort affordance.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
